content.text:
```json
{"cell_type": "Naive CD4+ T cell", "confidence": 0.72}
```

This cluster shows high CD3D (pan T-cell marker) together with MAL, which is a strong, relatively specific marker of naive (and central memory) CD4+ T cells, plus a broad set of ribosomal protein genes (RPS3, RPL6, RPL37, RPL24, RPL35A, RPL18, RPS14, EEF1A1) reflecting the high translational/housekeeping activity typical of quiescent naive lymphocytes. Together this profile is most consistent with a naive CD4+ T-cell population within PBMCs.
